passages.text:
Hi Nam,
I'm staying with my cousins at the beach this week. Every morning we swim before breakfast, because the sea is calm then. In the afternoon it's too hot, so we stay inside and play board games. Yesterday we went on a boat trip and saw three dolphins! I'm coming home on Saturday by train. See you at football practice on Sunday.
Minh

When Linh was twelve, she noticed that many families in her building had shelves full of books that nobody read any more. So she put a small wooden box next to the lift with a sign: 'Take a book, leave a book.' At first, only her neighbours on the third floor used it. Then a man from the ground floor built a second shelf, and children started leaving notes inside the books to say what they thought of them. Two years later, the box holds more than two hundred books. Linh says the best part is not the books themselves but the conversations people now have in the lift.

For years, parents have complained that teenagers are lazy because they stay in bed until noon at weekends. Scientists, however, now believe that the problem is not laziness but biology. During adolescence, the body starts to produce melatonin, the hormone that makes us sleepy, about two hours later in the evening than it did in childhood. As a result, a fourteen-year-old who goes to bed at ten may simply lie awake, unable to fall asleep. Some schools have responded by pushing back the start of lessons, and the early results are promising: students arrive more alert, and fewer of them doze off in class. Critics argue that a later start only moves the problem, since teenagers will just go to bed even later. So far, though, the figures do not support this view.

items.q: My sister ______ to school by bus every day.
items.explain_vi: Có ==every day== → thói quen, dùng **hiện tại đơn**; chủ ngữ số ít 'My sister' → **goes**. __Mẹo: chủ ngữ là he/she/it hoặc một người, động từ thêm -s/-es.__

items.q: We ______ at home last weekend because it was raining.
items.explain_vi: Có ==last weekend== → quá khứ; chủ ngữ 'We' đi với **were**. __Đừng chọn 'was': 'was' chỉ đi với I/he/she/it.__

items.q: My birthday is ______ 14th May.
items.explain_vi: ==14th May== là ngày cụ thể → dùng **on**. __Nhớ: at + giờ, on + ngày/thứ, in + tháng/năm.__

items.q: This is Tom's bag, and that one is ______ too.
items.explain_vi: Chỗ trống đứng một mình ở cuối câu, nghĩa là 'của cậu ấy' → **đại từ sở hữu his**. 'him' là tân ngữ, 'he's' là 'he is'. __Mẹo: sau chỗ trống không có danh từ thì cần đại từ sở hữu.__

items.q: I'm hungry. Can I have a ______ of bread?
items.explain_vi: ==bread== là đồ ăn cắt được → **a slice of bread** (một lát bánh mì). __'glass' và 'bottle' dùng cho đồ uống, 'bowl' cho cơm/súp.__

items.q: Please ______ the door. It's cold in here.
items.explain_vi: Có ==It's cold in here== → cần đóng cửa: **close the door**. 'wear' là mặc, 'make' là làm ra. __Đọc câu sau chỗ trống để hiểu lý do.__

items.q: My grandfather is 80, but he is still very ______. He walks five kilometres every day.
items.explain_vi: Có ==He walks five kilometres every day== → ông rất **active** (năng động). __Ba từ còn lại (tired, lazy, ill) trái nghĩa với ý câu, loại ngay.__

items.q: It's very ______ today, so take your umbrella. (RAIN)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==very== cần **tính từ**: rain + -y → **rainy** (có mưa). __Mẹo: thời tiết thường thêm -y: sunny, windy, cloudy.__

items.q: Why do Minh and his cousins swim before breakfast?
options: It is too hot in the morning.
They have breakfast at the beach.
The sea is calm at that time.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="Every morning we swim before breakfast, because the sea is calm then."== → đáp án **The sea is calm at that time**. __Cẩn thận: trời nóng là buổi chiều, không phải buổi sáng.__

items.q: What will Minh do on Sunday?
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="See you at football practice on Sunday."== → **Go to football practice**. __Về nhà bằng tàu là thứ Bảy, đi thuyền là hôm qua; để ý từ chỉ thời gian.__

items.q: You've finished your homework, ______?
items.explain_vi: Vế trước khẳng định ==You've finished== (have) → đuôi phủ định cùng trợ động từ: **haven't you?** __Mẹo: tìm trợ động từ ở vế trước rồi đổi dấu, không dùng 'did/do'.__

items.q: ______ the heavy rain, the match still went ahead.
items.explain_vi: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ ==the heavy rain== → **Despite + danh từ**. __'Although' phải đi với mệnh đề (S + V); 'However' đứng riêng và có dấu phẩy.__

items.q:
A: I don't like horror films.
B: ______ do I. They're too scary.
items.explain_vi: Câu A phủ định ==don't like== → đồng ý dùng **Neither do I** (tớ cũng không). __'So do I' chỉ dùng sau câu khẳng định.__

items.q: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ______.
items.explain_vi: Có ==By the time we arrived== (quá khứ đơn) → việc xảy ra trước đó dùng **quá khứ hoàn thành: had started**. __Mẹo: by the time + quá khứ đơn, vế kia thường là had + V3.__

items.q: Please ______ attention to the instructions before you start the test.
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định: **pay attention to** (chú ý đến). __Học cả cụm: pay attention, take care, make a decision.__

items.q: Could you ______ my cat while I'm on holiday next week?
items.explain_vi: Có ==while I'm on holiday== → nhờ chăm mèo: **look after** (chăm sóc). __'look for' là tìm, 'look up' là tra cứu, 'look into' là điều tra.__

items.q: I'm afraid I can't come to your party. I've got a bad ______ and I can't stop coughing.
items.explain_vi: Có ==I can't stop coughing== → **have a bad cold** (bị cảm nặng). __'ache' phải ghép (headache, toothache), không nói 'a bad temperature'.__

items.q: Their ______ began in Grade 1, and they are still best friends today. (FRIEND)
items.explain_vi: Sau tính từ sở hữu ==Their== cần **danh từ**: friend + -ship → **friendship** (tình bạn). __Mẹo: xem từ đứng trước chỗ trống để đoán từ loại.__

items.q: Why did Linh start the book box?
options: Her school asked her to do it.
The library near her building had closed.
She wanted to sell her old books.
Many families had books they no longer read.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="many families in her building had shelves full of books that nobody read any more"== → **Many families had books they no longer read**. __Các ý khác không có trong bài, loại ngay.__

items.q: What does Linh like most about the project?
options: The way neighbours now talk to each other
The notes that children leave in the books
The second shelf built by a neighbour
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="the best part is not the books themselves but the conversations people now have in the lift"== → **The way neighbours now talk to each other**. __Cấu trúc 'not A but B': ý chính nằm ở B.__

items.q: Hardly ______ the house when it started to pour with rain.
items.explain_vi: Có ==Hardly== đứng đầu câu → đảo ngữ: **Hardly + had + S + V3 ... when ...** → **had we left**. __Mẹo: thấy Hardly/No sooner đầu câu, đưa trợ động từ lên trước chủ ngữ.__

items.q: I'd rather you ______ tell anyone about this yet.
items.explain_vi: Có ==I'd rather you== → **would rather + S + quá khứ đơn** để nói mong muốn về người khác → **didn't**. __Dù nghĩa là hiện tại, vẫn lùi về quá khứ.__

items.q: She ______ have seen me. She walked straight past without saying hello.
items.explain_vi: Có ==She walked straight past without saying hello== → chắc chắn cô ấy đã không nhìn thấy: **can't have + V3**. __Đừng nhầm 'needn't have' (lẽ ra không cần làm).__

items.q: It's high time we ______ for the airport, or we'll miss the flight.
items.explain_vi: Có ==It's high time== → **It's high time + S + quá khứ đơn** → **left**. __Mẹo: sau 'It's time / It's high time / It's about time + S' luôn dùng quá khứ đơn.__

items.q: The concert was ______ off because the singer had lost her voice.
items.explain_vi: Có ==the singer had lost her voice== → buổi diễn bị huỷ: **call off** (huỷ bỏ). __'drop off' là ngủ gật/thả xuống xe, 'give off' là toả ra, 'break off' là cắt đứt.__

items.q: After months of training, the team finally ______ their goal of playing in the final.
items.explain_vi: Kết hợp từ: **achieve a goal** (đạt được mục tiêu). __'win' đi với trận đấu/giải thưởng; không nói 'earn/gain a goal' với nghĩa này.__

items.q: Lan ______ a lot of effort into her science project, and it really showed.
items.explain_vi: Có ==effort into== → cụm cố định **put effort into something** (dồn công sức vào). __'make an effort' không đi với 'into', nên loại 'made'.__

items.q: There must be a ______. I ordered tea, not coffee. (UNDERSTAND)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==a== cần **danh từ** nghĩa là sự hiểu lầm: mis- + understand + -ing → **misunderstanding**. __Mẹo: tiền tố mis- mang nghĩa 'sai, nhầm'.__

items.q: According to the passage, why do many teenagers find it hard to fall asleep early?
options: Their bodies start producing a sleep hormone later in the evening.
They spend too long looking at their phones at night.
Their schools start lessons too late in the morning.
They are lazier than they were as children.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="the body starts to produce melatonin ... about two hours later in the evening"== → **cơ thể tiết hormone gây buồn ngủ muộn hơn**. __Bài phủ nhận ý 'lười' và không nhắc tới điện thoại.__

items.q: What is the writer's attitude towards later school start times?
options: worried about how much they cost
sure that they will fail in the long term
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="the early results are promising"== và =="the figures do not support this view"== → thái độ **generally positive**. __Tìm tính từ đánh giá của tác giả để đoán thái độ.__

passages.text:
Dear Grandma,
Thank you for the birthday present! I wear the blue jacket every day because our classroom is very cold in the morning. On Saturday, Mum took me and four friends to the zoo for my party. We saw two baby elephants and then ate pizza in the park. Next month I'm visiting you with Dad. Can we go fishing again?
Love,
Hoa

Last year, Quân's class turned an empty corner of the school yard into a vegetable garden. The idea came from their science teacher, who wanted students to see where food really comes from. At first, many students thought gardening would be boring, and insects ate most of the first tomatoes. Instead of giving up, the class asked a farmer for advice and planted flowers between the vegetables to keep the insects away. This spring, they grew enough lettuce to sell at the school fair. Quân says the money was nice, but he is prouder that his classmates now argue about whose turn it is to water the plants.

Many students believe they can do their homework while chatting with friends online, and some even claim it helps them stay calm. Psychologists are not convinced. Their studies show that the brain does not really do two things at once; instead, it switches quickly between tasks, and every switch costs a little time and attention. Over an evening, these small losses add up, so homework that should take one hour may take ninety minutes, and the work is often less accurate. Interestingly, the people who consider themselves good at multitasking tend to perform worst in tests. This does not mean phones must be banned from bedrooms. A simple rule, such as checking messages only after finishing each subject, seems to bring most of the benefits without making teenagers feel cut off from their friends.

items.q: ______ your brother like ice cream?
items.explain_vi: Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn với động từ thường ==like==, chủ ngữ số ít 'your brother' → **Does**. __Mẹo: có động từ thường thì dùng Do/Does, không dùng Is/Are.__

items.q: I ______ my keys yesterday, so I couldn't open the door.
items.explain_vi: Có ==yesterday== → **quá khứ đơn**; 'lose' bất quy tắc: lose – **lost** – lost. __Không có dạng 'losed'; học thuộc bảng động từ bất quy tắc.__

items.q: The film starts ______ 7.30, so please don't be late.
items.explain_vi: ==7.30== là giờ cụ thể → dùng **at**. __Nhớ: at + giờ, on + ngày, in + tháng/năm.__

items.q: These are my sister's shoes. Please give them to ______.
items.explain_vi: Sau giới từ ==to== cần **đại từ tân ngữ: her**. 'she' là chủ ngữ, 'hers' là 'của cô ấy'. __Mẹo: sau giới từ và sau động từ luôn dùng tân ngữ (me, him, her...).__

items.q: I'm thirsty. Can I have a ______ of orange juice, please?
items.explain_vi: ==orange juice== là đồ uống → **a glass of** (một cốc). __'slice/piece' dùng cho đồ ăn, 'loaf' là ổ bánh mì.__

items.q: It's raining outside. Don't forget to take your ______.
items.explain_vi: Có ==It's raining outside== → mang **umbrella** (ô). __Các đồ còn lại không dùng để che mưa.__

items.q: My little brother is very ______. He always smiles and talks to new people.
items.explain_vi: Có ==He always smiles and talks to new people== → **friendly** (thân thiện). __'quiet' và 'shy' trái nghĩa với ý câu, loại trước.__

items.q: It's ______ today, so let's go to the park and fly a kite. (WIND)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==It's== cần **tính từ chỉ thời tiết**: wind + -y → **windy** (có gió). __Gợi ý 'fly a kite' cũng cho thấy trời có gió.__

items.q: Why does Hoa wear the blue jacket every day?
options: Her classroom is cold in the morning.
Her mum told her to wear it.
She wants to wear it to the zoo.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="I wear the blue jacket every day because our classroom is very cold in the morning."== → **Her classroom is cold in the morning**. __Thấy câu hỏi 'Why', tìm từ 'because' trong bài.__

items.q: What does Hoa want to do next month?
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="Next month I'm visiting you with Dad. Can we go fishing again?"== → **Go fishing with Grandma**. __Đi sở thú và ăn pizza là thứ Bảy vừa rồi; để ý mốc thời gian.__

items.q: Your parents haven't met my teacher yet, ______?
items.explain_vi: Vế trước phủ định ==haven't met== → đuôi khẳng định cùng trợ động từ: **have they?** __Mẹo: 'Your parents' thay bằng 'they'; giữ nguyên trợ động từ 'have'.__

items.q: ______ she was very tired, she carried on studying until midnight.
items.explain_vi: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề ==she was very tired== (S + V) → **Although**. __'Despite/In spite of' đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing; 'In spite' thiếu 'of'.__

items.q:
A: I've never been abroad.
B: ______ have I. I'd love to go one day.
items.explain_vi: Có ==never== → câu mang nghĩa phủ định → đồng ý dùng **Neither have I** (tớ cũng chưa từng). __Đừng chọn 'So': 'So' chỉ dùng sau câu khẳng định.__

items.q: When I got to the station, the train ______, so I had to wait an hour for the next one.
items.explain_vi: Có ==When I got to the station== → tàu rời đi TRƯỚC khi tôi đến → **quá khứ hoàn thành: had already left**. __Việc nào xảy ra trước trong quá khứ thì dùng had + V3.__

items.q: I always ______ a lot of mistakes when I write in a hurry.
items.explain_vi: Kết hợp từ: **make a mistake** (mắc lỗi). __Lỗi hay gặp: nói 'do a mistake' là sai.__

items.q: We've ______ milk, so I'll go to the shop and buy some more.
items.explain_vi: Có ==I'll go to the shop and buy some more== → sữa đã hết: **run out of**. __'run into' là tình cờ gặp, 'run after' là đuổi theo, 'run over' là cán qua.__

items.q: Eating fruit, vegetables and some protein every day is part of a ______ diet.
items.explain_vi: Kết hợp từ: **a balanced diet** (chế độ ăn cân bằng). __Không nói 'fair/equal/even diet'; học cả cụm.__

items.q: To use the swimming pool, you need a ______ card. (MEMBER)
items.explain_vi: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ ==card== → cần **danh từ ghép**: member + -ship → **membership** (thẻ hội viên). __Mẹo: -ship tạo danh từ: friendship, membership.__

items.q: Whose idea was the vegetable garden?
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="The idea came from their science teacher"== → **Their science teacher's**. __Cẩn thận: người nông dân chỉ cho lời khuyên sau đó.__

items.q: What is Quân most proud of?
options: The money they made at the fair
The tomatoes they grew in the first year
The flowers they planted between the vegetables
How keen his classmates now are to look after the plants
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="he is prouder that his classmates now argue about whose turn it is to water the plants"== → **các bạn giờ rất muốn chăm cây**. __Tiền thì 'nice' nhưng 'prouder' mới là điều tự hào nhất.__

items.q: No sooner ______ onto the stage than the audience began to cheer.
items.explain_vi: Có ==No sooner== đầu câu → đảo ngữ: **No sooner + had + S + V3 ... than ...** → **had she stepped**. __Mẹo: No sooner đi với 'than', Hardly đi với 'when'.__

items.q: I'd rather you ______ your phone during dinner.
items.explain_vi: Có ==I'd rather you== → **would rather + S + quá khứ đơn** → **didn't use**. __Dù nói về hiện tại, vẫn dùng quá khứ đơn sau chủ ngữ thứ hai.__

items.q: The experiment ______ have gone wrong. The results look perfect.
items.explain_vi: Có ==The results look perfect== → chắc chắn thí nghiệm không hỏng: **can't have + V3**. __'needn't have' là lẽ ra không cần làm, khác nghĩa.__

items.q: It's about time you ______ your room. It's a complete mess!
items.explain_vi: Có ==It's about time== → **It's about time + S + quá khứ đơn** → **tidied**. __Mẹo: It's time / high time / about time + S luôn đi với quá khứ đơn.__

items.q: After weeks of failed experiments, the team finally ______ a cheaper way to clean the water.
items.explain_vi: Có ==a cheaper way to clean the water== → nghĩ ra giải pháp: **come up with**. __'come across' là tình cờ thấy, 'come down with' là bị ốm, 'come round to' là dần chấp nhận.__

items.q: The new school rules will ______ effect next Monday.
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định: **take effect** (bắt đầu có hiệu lực). __Có ==next Monday== → luật mới sẽ bắt đầu áp dụng.__

items.q: She ______ most of her free time to helping at the animal shelter.
items.explain_vi: Có ==to helping== → **devote time to + V-ing** (dành thời gian cho việc gì). __'spend time' đi với 'on' hoặc V-ing, không đi với 'to'.__

items.q: Sorry, I ______ the question, so my answer was completely wrong. (UNDERSTAND)
items.explain_vi: Có ==my answer was completely wrong== → hiểu sai: mis- + understand → **misunderstood** (quá khứ). __Nhớ: understand – understood, nên misunderstand – misunderstood.__

items.q: According to psychologists, what happens when we try to do two things at the same time?
options: The brain moves rapidly from one task to the other.
The brain does both tasks equally well.
We become calmer and more focused.
We completely forget the first task.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="the brain does not really do two things at once; instead, it switches quickly between tasks"== → **The brain moves rapidly from one task to the other**. __'switches quickly' được diễn đạt lại thành 'moves rapidly'.__

items.q: What is the writer's view on phones and homework?
options: Phones should be banned from bedrooms.
Students who multitask get the best results.
A sensible rule works better than a total ban.
Messages should always be answered quickly.
items.explain_vi: Bài đọc: =="This does not mean phones must be banned from bedrooms. A simple rule ... seems to bring most of the benefits"== → **A sensible rule works better than a total ban**. __Ý kiến tác giả thường nằm ở cuối bài.__
